facilities.name: Greenville Free Medical Clinic
facilities.source: Clinic operators' own published locations pages: greenvillefreeclinic.org and taylorsfmc.org, read 2026-08-31
facilities.open_hours: Mon 8:45am-5pm; Tue 9:45am-7pm; Wed 8:45am-5pm; Thu 9:45am-7pm; Fri 8:45am-1pm. In-house pharmacy opens 45 minutes later each day and closes with the clinic.
facilities.notes: Main site. General and specialty medical, limited dental, behavioral health and counseling, health education, in-house pharmacy. Closed New Year's Eve and Day, Memorial Day, Independence Day, Labor Day, Thanksgiving and the day after, Christmas Eve and Day.
facilities.verification_note: Suzie Foley, executive director, confirmed 600 Arlington Avenue by phone. She also corrected the operator's own site on two points, services and hours, which is recorded against the reproductive_health candidate row.

facilities.source: Clinic operators' own published locations pages: greenvillefreeclinic.org and taylorsfmc.org, read 2026-08-31
facilities.open_hours: NEW PATIENT REGISTRATION: Wednesdays 9:00am to 11:30am only, no appointment needed. All provider visits are by appointment.
facilities.notes: Independent faith-based clinic, not a Greenville Free Medical Clinic site. Eligibility: household income at or below 165% of the federal poverty level, Greenville County resident, and no other health coverage including Medicare, Medicaid and VA benefits. Services include primary care, pharmacy, counseling, gynecology, cardiology, dermatology, orthopedics and chiropractic.
